0.title: Jack's Lighthouse
0.tagline: A lonely beacon above the breakers, long since stolen from its keeper.
0.description: A weathered stone lighthouse perched on the rocky shore north of the harbor of Khorinis. Its lantern once guided merchant ships and royal galleys safely into port, but with trade from the mainland all but dead the light is often cold.
0.history: When the hero arrives on Khorinis, the lighthouse has been occupied by bandits and its old keeper has been driven out. Clearing the ruffians lets Jack return to his post. Later, when a crew is assembled to sail the paladins' ship Esmeralda to the island of Irdorath, the old sea dog can be recruited as helmsman.

characters.name: Old Jack
characters.description: A gruff old salt who hangs around the harbor telling sea stories. He longs to reclaim his lighthouse and knows the waters around Khorinis better than anyone.

characters.name: Bandits
characters.description: A band of cutthroats who took over the tower and use it as a hideout overlooking the coast.

facts: Jack is one of the possible helmsmen for the voyage to Irdorath in Chapter 5.
From the gallery you can see the harbor district and the open sea toward the mainland.

1.title: Northern Grimwald
1.tagline: Dark pines, hungry wolves and the hunters brave enough to stalk them.
1.description: The thick forests north of the city are prime hunting grounds. Wolves, scavengers, molerats and young shadowbeasts roam beneath the trees, and the deeper you go the more dangerous the wildlife becomes.
1.history: Hunters from Khorinis sell their pelts to the bowyer Bosper in the lower quarter. With food scarce after the orc war, the forests have become a lifeline for city and farm alike, and a dangerous one for the inexperienced.

characters.name: Bartok
characters.description: A hunter who earns his living selling furs in the city. He can be persuaded to go hunting with the hero in the woods outside the walls.

characters.name: Bosper
characters.description: The master bowyer of Khorinis buys every wolf skin and pelt the hunters bring back.

facts: The northern woods connect to the hunters' trails leading toward the Black Troll's territory.

2.title: Black Troll Gorge
2.tagline: The lair of one of the deadliest beasts on Khorinis.
2.description: A rocky mountain basin with a cold lake in the north of the island. A Black Troll, one of the strongest creatures in the game, makes its home here, and few travelers come back from its shadow.
2.history: Black Trolls are rarer and far tougher than their brown cousins. Slaying one is a rite of passage for veteran hunters and an early-game challenge players love to attempt with clever tactics. The hunter Grimbald camps nearby, dreaming of the troll's trophy.

characters.name: Grimbald
characters.description: A bold hunter who camps close to the Black Troll's territory and is looking for a strong partner to hunt with.

characters.name: Black Troll
characters.description: A towering, coal-furred troll whose fists can kill an unprepared adventurer in a single blow.

facts: Black Troll fur and tusks are among the most valuable hunting trophies in Gothic II.

3.title: Niclas's Overlook
3.tagline: A hunter's lonely bluff above the lighthouse road.
3.description: A high, windswept bluff between the forests and the northern coast. From here the paths toward the lighthouse, the city and the northern woods can all be watched.
3.history: Many people fled the cramped streets of Khorinis when food grew scarce and the militia grew harsh. Some, like Niclas, chose the solitude of the wilderness, living off the hunt and trading meat and pelts.

characters.name: Niclas
characters.description: A quiet woodsman who prefers the company of the forest to city folk. He lives off the land and knows the local wildlife well.

facts: Hunters' camps like this one are good places to rest, cook raw meat and trade trophies.

4.title: Vino's Hollow
4.tagline: Where the farmhands' strongest brew is quietly distilled.
4.description: A sheltered forest hollow between the northern road and the stone circles. Its seclusion makes it an ideal place for activities the militia and the landowners need not know about.
4.history: Vino is one of Lobart's farmhands and is known for brewing strong liquor. Places like this, hidden in the woods near the farms, are where the farm workers make their drink away from prying eyes.

characters.name: Vino
characters.description: A hard-working field hand with a taste for strong drink. He brews liquor and is happy to share it with a friendly stranger.

characters.name: Lobart
characters.description: Vino's employer, whose farm lies just to the south-west.

facts: The name on the Gothic Fire map is spelled 'Vinno', after the in-game character Vino.

5.title: Circle of the Sun
5.tagline: Ancient stones where three mages restored the Eye of Innos.
5.description: A great megalithic stone circle high in the wooded hills. Older than the city and the monastery, it radiates a strange power and was chosen for one of the most important rituals in Gothic II.
5.history: In Chapter 3 the novice Pedro steals the Eye of Innos from the Monastery and the artifact is damaged by the Seekers. To restore it, the hero must unite Pyrokar of the Fire Mages, Vatras of the Water Mages and the necromancer Xardas, three men who distrust each other deeply, and bring them together at the Circle of the Sun. The broken amulet also has to be reforged by a master smith such as Bennet.

characters.name: Vatras
characters.description: Preaches at the temple of Adanos in Khorinis and leads the secret Ring of Water. He only agrees to the ritual after Xardas offers proof of good faith.

characters.name: Pyrokar
characters.description: Head of the Monastery of Innos and keeper of the Eye of Innos.

characters.name: Xardas
characters.description: The former Fire Mage turned master of black magic, who guides the hero through the fight against the dragons.

facts: The ritual at the Circle of the Sun ends Chapter 3 and opens the way to the dragon hunt.
The hunter Dragomir is said to have lost his crossbow to undead goblins near these stones.

6.title: Northgate Woods
6.tagline: The militia's last outpost before the wilderness.
6.description: Timber woods along the road that runs from the city gate toward Lobart's farm and the monastery. It is the most travelled road on the island, and the city militia keeps an eye on it.
6.history: With orcs, bandits and wild beasts roaming the countryside, the militia of Lord Andre patrols the roads closest to Khorinis. Travelers are warned not to stray too far from the path.

characters.name: Mika
characters.description: Stationed on the road outside the city. He warns newcomers about the dangers of the wilderness and, for a price, can lend a sword arm against troublemakers at Akil's farm.

characters.name: Lord Andre
characters.description: The paladin who commands the city watch and recruits new militiamen.

facts: Militiamen like Mika are loyal to the paladins and take a dim view of Onar's mercenaries.

7.title: Monastery of Innos
7.tagline: Fortress-sanctuary of the Fire Mages and home of the Eye of Innos.
7.description: A walled monastery on a rocky outcrop reachable only over a narrow bridge. It houses the Circle of Fire: the High Council of Fire Mages, the magicians who serve them, and the novices who work the gardens, wine press and sheep pens.
7.history: In Gothic the Fire Mages of the Old Camp were sent into the Barrier from this order. In Gothic II, the monastery guards the Eye of Innos. A newcomer can only join as a novice by bringing a sheep and 1000 gold as an offering. Novices who prove themselves may undergo the Trial of Fire to become magicians. The library holds ancient knowledge, and the monastery's cellar hides passages and secrets of its own.

characters.name: Pyrokar
characters.description: Head of the High Council and leader of the monastery. Stern but wise, he holds the Eye of Innos.

characters.name: Ulthar & Serpentes
characters.description: The other two members of the High Council. Serpentes in particular is suspicious of the hero and sets him harsh tests.

characters.name: Parlan
characters.description: Assigns work to novices and oversees their duties.

characters.name: Milten
characters.description: The hero's old friend from the Old Camp. In Gothic 3 he is found among the Fire Mages of Nordmar.

characters.name: Pedro
characters.description: Guards the gate at the start of the game, and later betrays the order by stealing the Eye of Innos.

facts: Joining the monastery requires a sheep and 1000 gold, or a clever alternative.
Fire Mages specialize in fire runes and healing magic, and can enchant the hero's arms.

8.title: Snapper Gorge
8.tagline: A canyon prowled by snappers and haunted by a novice's failed trial.
8.description: A deep ravine below the monastery cliffs. Packs of snappers, fast and vicious raptor-like lizards, hunt in its shadows, and hidden caves riddle the rock walls.
8.history: During the Trial of Magic, novices of the monastery compete to follow a series of clues into the wilderness. The ambitious novice Agon goes to great lengths to win and waits for the hero in a cave at the end of the trail.

characters.name: Agon
characters.description: Arrogant and jealous of rivals, Agon will do anything to become a magician, including ambushing a competitor.

characters.name: Igaranz & Dyrian
characters.description: Fellow candidates in the Trial of Magic, each with their own fate.

facts: Snappers hunt in packs. Lure them one at a time if you value your life.

9.title: Misty Cliffs
9.tagline: Fog, sea spray and the hideouts of those who fled the law.
9.description: Fog-shrouded ocean cliffs on the north-eastern coast. Old watch posts crumble into the sea and few roads reach this wild stretch of shoreline.
9.history: Thieves who make Khorinis too hot for themselves often flee into the wilderness. The market thief Rengaru, who robbed the merchant Jora, is one such fugitive from the militia.

characters.name: Rengaru
characters.description: A petty thief who stole from the merchant Jora on the Khorinis market and fled the city's justice.

facts: Remote coastal areas of Khorinis are a favored landing spot for smugglers.

10.title: Shipwreck Cove
10.tagline: Rotting hulls, fire lizards and pirate rumors.
10.description: An isolated eastern beach scattered with the wreckage of ships broken on the reefs. Fire lizards bask on the warm sand and treasure hunters comb the hulls for anything of value.
10.history: The waters around Khorinis are home to pirates. In Night of the Raven, Captain Greg's crew operates from a cove in Jharkendar and smuggles goods to Khorinis. Wrecks like these feed rumors of buried pirate treasure.

characters.name: Captain Greg
characters.description: The one-eyed, short-tempered captain of the pirates in Night of the Raven, who returns to find his camp threatened by Raven's bandits.

characters.name: Fire lizards
characters.description: Fire-breathing lizards that make the beaches dangerous for the unprepared.

11.title: Khorinis City Gate
11.tagline: The guarded threshold of the last free city on the island.
11.description: The fortified gatehouse on the landward side of Khorinis. Militia guards turn away anyone who looks like a vagrant or a refugee from the Valley of Mines.
11.history: Getting into the city is the hero's first challenge in Gothic II. The guards can be fooled by wearing farmer's clothes from Lobart's farm, by carrying a trader's pass, or by claiming a plausible reason to enter. Inside, paladins under Lord Hagen have imposed martial law.

characters.name: City guards
characters.description: Gatekeepers under orders to keep out riff-raff and anyone who might be an escaped convict.

characters.name: Lothar
characters.description: A paladin who explains the city's rules to newcomers. His murder in Chapter 3 is blamed on the smith Bennet.

facts: There are several ways past the gate guards. Choosing one is a classic Gothic II moment.

12.title: Canthar's Crossroads
12.tagline: A friendly merchant with a pass to sell and a debt to collect.
12.description: A crossroads on the main road connecting the city, Lobart's farm and the paths north. Traveling merchants wait here for customers too poor or too suspicious to be let inside the walls.
12.history: Canthar offers the hero a trader's pass that will get him past the city guards, in exchange for a favor to be named later. The favor turns out to be a scheme to frame the market trader Sarah so that Canthar can take her stall.

characters.name: Canthar
characters.description: Smooth-talking and helpful on the surface, Canthar is a schemer who always collects on his favors.

facts: Canthar's deal is an early lesson in Gothic's morally gray choices.

13.title: Isgaroth's Shrine
13.tagline: A roadside shrine of Innos at the foot of the monastery road.
13.description: A stone bridge and a small shrine of Innos near the crossroads below the monastery. Pilgrims and novices stop here to pray before the climb.
13.history: The Fire Mage Isgaroth tends the shrine and blesses travelers. He is often the first magician of Innos a newcomer meets, and he points those interested in the order toward the monastery gate.

characters.name: Master Isgaroth
characters.description: Keeper of the roadside shrine. He offers blessings and advice to those who honor Innos.

facts: Praying at shrines of Innos can grant blessings to the faithful.

14.title: City of Khorinis
14.tagline: Port city under martial law: paladins, merchants, thieves and mages.
14.description: The only city on the island, divided into the lower quarter, the market, the upper quarter with the town hall and the paladins' headquarters, and the harbor district. The temple of Adanos stands at the market square, and a thieves' guild operates in the sewers beneath the harbor.
14.history: In Gothic, Khorinis was the port through which magic ore from the Penal Colony was shipped to King Rhobar II. In Gothic II, Lord Hagen and his paladins have landed to secure the ore and have taken control of the city from Governor Larius. With food short and the farmers in revolt, tension runs high.

characters.name: Lord Hagen
characters.description: The king's representative on Khorinis. He wants to secure the ore and will listen only to someone who can prove the dragons exist.

characters.name: Lord Andre
characters.description: Recruits and leads the city watch.

characters.name: Vatras
characters.description: Preaches at the temple of Adanos and secretly leads the Ring of Water.

characters.name: Harad, Bosper, Constantino, Thorben & Matteo
characters.description: The five masters of the lower quarter. The hero must win their approval to become an apprentice and a citizen.

characters.name: Cassia
characters.description: Runs the guild hidden in the sewers.

facts: Becoming a citizen of Khorinis is required to join the militia or the paladins.
The paladins' ship Esmeralda lies at anchor in the harbor.

15.title: Lobart's Farm
15.tagline: The farm closest to the city, and the hero's way past the gate.
15.description: A modest but productive farm just outside the city walls, with turnip fields, a barn and a farmhouse. It sells most of its harvest to Khorinis.
15.history: Unlike Onar, Lobart still trades with the city, which makes him a target for the mercenaries' contempt. The hero can earn farmer's clothes here by doing chores such as chasing field raiders off the fields, and wear them to slip into the city.

characters.name: Lobart
characters.description: An honest, hard-working farmer who stays loyal to the city even though the paladins requisition much of his food.

characters.name: Hilda
characters.description: Runs the household and sends the hero on small errands.

characters.name: Vino & Maleth
characters.description: Workers on Lobart's fields.

facts: Lobart's farm is often the very first place where a new player earns gold and gear.

16.title: Erol's Bridge
16.tagline: A merchant's ruin beside the road to the Dead Harpy.
16.description: A stone bridge on the road between the city and the Dead Harpy tavern. Bandits watch this route closely, and travelers often lose their purses here.
16.history: Erol was once a respectable merchant until bandits ambushed him on the road and stole his goods. He now lives near the bridge and asks the hero to recover what was taken from him.

characters.name: Erol
characters.description: A once-prosperous trader reduced to living by the roadside after a bandit ambush.

facts: Bandit ambushes become more frequent once the hero's wanted posters start circulating in Night of the Raven.

17.title: Sekob's Farm
17.tagline: A tenant farmer who would rather not pay his rent.
17.description: One of the tenant farms in the broad valley ruled by the landowner Onar. Its wheat fields are rich, though field raiders and wolves constantly threaten the harvest.
17.history: Sekob owes rent to Onar and keeps finding excuses not to pay. As part of the test to join the mercenaries, Torlof sends the hero to collect Sekob's overdue rent by whatever means necessary.

characters.name: Sekob
characters.description: A miserly farmer who resents both Onar and his mercenary rent collectors.

characters.name: Torlof
characters.description: A former sailor in Lee's mercenaries who tests new recruits.

facts: The woods behind Sekob's farm hide both Sagitta's grotto and a bandit camp tied to the 'missing people' quest.

18.title: Crypt of Inubis
18.tagline: A sealed tomb where an undead lord waits with his skeleton mages.
18.description: A stone crypt hidden in the forest east of Onar's estate. Skeletons wander outside, and inside the dead stir the moment the treasure chests are disturbed.
18.history: The crypt is guarded by the Undead Lord Inubis together with skeleton mages that freeze and summon more undead. Although it has no logbook quest, clearing it early is a famous challenge, rewarding thousands of experience points and a powerful two-handed sword.

characters.name: Inubis
characters.description: A long-dead warrior lord risen as a fearsome undead champion, wielding a heavy two-handed blade.

characters.name: Skeleton mages
characters.description: Kill them first: their ice spells and summons can quickly overwhelm intruders.

facts: Many players save a Rain of Fire scroll specifically for this crypt.

19.title: Sagitta's Grove
19.tagline: The healer of the woods and her cave of herbs and potions.
19.description: A secluded cave in the forest behind Sekob's farm, hung with drying herbs and filled with bottles and mortars.
19.history: Sagitta is an herbalist and healer who lives apart from both the city and the farms. She sells potions and ingredients and heals those who make the trip to her grotto. Herbs from these woods are prized by alchemists across the island.

characters.name: Sagitta
characters.description: A wise, independent woman who prefers the forest's peace to the politics of farm and city.

facts: Healing plants and fire nettles grow in the surrounding forest.

20.title: Akil's Farm
20.tagline: A hilltop farm threatened by thugs at the top of the stone stairs.
20.description: A small farm at the top of a long stone stairway between the city and the Dead Harpy. Its fields are fertile, but its position makes it an easy mark.
20.history: Early in Gothic II, two thugs named Alvares and Engardo have taken to extorting Akil. The hero can drive them off, with or without the militiaman Mika's help, and earn the family's gratitude.

characters.name: Akil
characters.description: A peaceful farmer struggling to protect his family and harvest.

characters.name: Kati
characters.description: Runs the farm kitchen and is grateful to anyone who helps them.

characters.name: Randolph
characters.description: A worker on Akil's farm who is a little too fond of drink.

facts: The long stone stairs to Akil's farm are one of the most recognizable landmarks on Khorinis.

21.title: Tavern 'Under the Dead Harpy'
21.tagline: The island's central inn, where every road and rumor meets.
21.description: A roadside tavern at the main crossroads between the city, Onar's lands, the monastery and the pass. Hunters, mercenaries, farmers and travelers all drink here.
21.history: Orlan runs the inn and rents out rooms to weary travelers. Because the tavern sits between paladin and mercenary territory, it is one of the few neutral places on the island. Rumors about the Valley of Mines, the bandits and the dragons pass through its doors first.

characters.name: Orlan
characters.description: A pragmatic tavern owner who serves anyone with gold and stays out of politics.

characters.name: Rukhar
characters.description: A rough patron fond of drinking contests, which are not always fair.

facts: The Dead Harpy is a natural meeting point between the city and Onar's farm.

22.title: Crossroads Graveyard
22.tagline: Old graves near the tavern, restless after dark.
22.description: An overgrown cemetery with a mossy mausoleum between the tavern and Onar's fields. At night the dead are said not to rest easily.
22.history: Lares, the former leader of the rogues of the New Camp and now a member of the Ring of Water, knows the hidden paths across the island. He guides the hero to the stone circle where the Water Mages' secrets lie and later escorts him toward Onar's farm.

characters.name: Lares
characters.description: Former rogue leader from Gothic, now a trusted agent of Vatras. He reappears in Gothic 3 on the mainland of Myrtana.

facts: Graveyards and crypts across Khorinis attract zombies and skeletons, especially after Chapter 3.

23.title: Onar's Farm
23.tagline: The landowner's estate, defended by Lee's mercenaries.
23.description: The largest estate on Khorinis: a manor, barns, a smithy, a mercenaries' camp and vast fields worked by tenant farmers. Onar has stopped paying taxes and sending food to the city, and hired mercenaries to keep the paladins out.
23.history: The mercenaries are largely veterans of the New Camp from Gothic, led by General Lee, who escaped the Barrier and wants to sail to the mainland to take revenge on King Rhobar for his betrayal. To join them the hero must pass Torlof's tests and win the mercenaries' votes.

characters.name: Onar
characters.description: A greedy, proud farmer who defies the king and pays mercenaries to protect his independence.

characters.name: Lee
characters.description: A former general framed and imprisoned by King Rhobar, now planning his return to the mainland. In Gothic 3 he finally stands in the royal palace of Vengard.

characters.name: Torlof
characters.description: A former sailor who tests new recruits.

characters.name: Thekla
characters.description: Runs the farm kitchen and feeds the mercenaries, and is always ready to give an opinion.

characters.name: Wolf
characters.description: A former hunter from the New Camp who can craft armor from monster hides.

facts: Joining the mercenaries leads to the path of the Dragon Hunters.
Many of the mercenaries were formerly members of the New Camp in Gothic.

24.title: Mercenary Grounds
24.tagline: Bennet's smithy, the training yard and Sylvio's grumbling faction.
24.description: The training fields, smithy and sheep pastures on the eastern edge of Onar's estate. Mercenaries spar here, and the forge rings from dawn to dusk.
24.history: Bennet, the finest smith on the island, is arrested in the city in Chapter 3 and accused of murdering the paladin Lothar. Proving his innocence is crucial, since only a master smith can reforge the Eye of Innos. Meanwhile Sylvio leads a faction of mercenaries critical of Lee and later sets off for the Valley of Mines to hunt dragons himself.

characters.name: Bennet
characters.description: A skilled blacksmith who forges the finest weapons on Khorinis and can join the voyage to Irdorath.

characters.name: Sylvio
characters.description: Ambitious and arrogant, he resents Lee's authority.

characters.name: Bullco
characters.description: A brute who shadows Sylvio and picks fights with newcomers.

25.title: Khorinis Harbor
25.tagline: Docks, taverns, the Red Lantern and the paladins' great ship.
25.description: The poorest quarter of the city, full of fishermen, dock workers, cutthroats and sailors without ships. Kardif's tavern, the brothel known as the Red Lantern and Lehmar the moneylender all do business here.
25.history: The paladins' galleon Esmeralda lies at anchor under heavy guard. In Chapter 5, the hero gathers a crew and takes the ship to sail to the island of Irdorath, where the Undead Dragon awaits. The Ring of Water also keeps an eye on the harbor through Lares.

characters.name: Kardif
characters.description: Sells drinks and information in equal measure.

characters.name: Bromor
characters.description: Runs the harbor brothel.

characters.name: Lehmar
characters.description: Lends gold at steep interest and has thugs to collect it.

characters.name: Halvor
characters.description: Sells fish, and quietly fences stolen goods.

facts: The harbor is the gateway to the final chapter of Gothic II.

26.title: Smugglers' Beach
26.tagline: A hidden cove where pirates trade with Khorinis merchants.
26.description: A sheltered cove south of the harbor, out of sight of the militia's watchtowers. Sea caves provide storage for goods that never pass through customs.
26.history: In Night of the Raven, the pirate Skip lands here to trade with the merchant Baltram, bringing goods from Jharkendar and taking supplies back to Captain Greg's camp. Following this trade leads the hero to the pirates.

characters.name: Skip
characters.description: A cheerful pirate who handles deliveries between Greg's crew and Khorinis.

characters.name: Baltram
characters.description: A market trader who secretly does business with the pirates.

27.title: Cavalorn's Valley
27.tagline: An old friend's hunting cabin on the road to the city.
27.description: A sheltered valley along the path that leads from Xardas's tower toward Khorinis. A small hunter's hut stands here, overrun by bandits and goblins.
27.history: Cavalorn was a hunter near the Old Camp in Gothic and taught the hero archery and sneaking. In Gothic II he is a member of the Ring of Water. Early in the game he is found at his old hut, troubled by bandits, and asks for help clearing them out.

characters.name: Cavalorn
characters.description: A skilled archer and old acquaintance of the hero from the Penal Colony.

facts: Cavalorn's valley is one of the first areas the hero passes through in Gothic II.

28.title: Bandit Bridge
28.tagline: A ravine crossing where bandits keep their captives.
28.description: A wooden bridge across a deep ravine between the central farmlands and the southern pastures. A bandit camp hidden nearby controls who crosses.
28.history: In Night of the Raven, citizens are going missing from Khorinis. Elvrich, the carpenter Thorben's apprentice, ran away with Lucia, a girl from the Red Lantern, only to be captured by bandits. He is found held in a bandit camp south-east of Bengar's farm, where the bandits were trading prisoners to be shipped away.

characters.name: Elvrich
characters.description: Thorben's nephew and apprentice, kidnapped by bandits while eloping.

characters.name: Lucia
characters.description: Elvrich's sweetheart. Her trail leads all the way to the bandit camp in Jharkendar.

facts: The missing people of Khorinis are being taken to work in Raven's gold mine in Jharkendar.

29.title: Dragomir's Camp
29.tagline: A hunters' campfire in the open meadows.
29.description: An open meadow with a hunter's campfire not far from the Dead Harpy tavern, where hunters rest between expeditions into the hills.
29.history: The hunter Dragomir was chased by monsters while hunting and dropped his beloved crossbow in his flight. He asks the hero to find it, and can later train crossbow skills.

characters.name: Dragomir
characters.description: A seasoned crossbowman and trainer who camps near the tavern.

30.title: Onar's Wheatfields
30.tagline: Golden fields that feed the mercenaries, and the field raiders that plague them.
30.description: The broad, fertile wheat and turnip fields south of Onar's manor, dotted with a marshy lake and sheep pastures.
30.history: Onar's fields produce the food that the city so desperately needs, and that Onar refuses to sell. Field raiders, giant locust-like insects, ravage the crops, and clearing them is one of the many jobs a would-be mercenary can take on. The mercenaries guarding the fields are always looking for a wager.

characters.name: Rod
characters.description: A brawny mercenary who bets newcomers that they can't even lift his sword.

characters.name: Pepe
characters.description: Tends Onar's sheep, though wolves keep stealing them.

facts: Field raiders are among the first real threats a new character faces.

31.title: Dexter's Hideout
31.tagline: The bandit chief who put a price on the hero's head.
31.description: A fortified stone house on a hill overlooking the valley, guarded by bandits and surrounded by palisades and archers.
31.history: Dexter, an ex-convict of the Old Camp, leads the bandits on Khorinis in Night of the Raven. He spreads wanted posters with the hero's face across the island and organizes the kidnapping of citizens for Raven. Defeating him uncovers proof that the missing people are being sent to Jharkendar.

characters.name: Dexter
characters.description: A former Old Camp shadow turned bandit chief, working for the former ore baron Raven.

facts: Dexter's letter is the first concrete link between the kidnappings and Raven.

32.title: High Pasture Steps
32.tagline: The stone stairway where mercenaries keep watch.
32.description: A long stone stairway climbing from the central plains to Bengar's high plateau and the road to the pass.
32.history: Cord was a mercenary in the New Camp in Gothic and is now one of the most respected fighters among Lee's men. He trains warriors in one-handed and two-handed combat, but only those who have earned the mercenaries' trust.

characters.name: Cord
characters.description: A veteran mercenary and one of the best combat trainers on Khorinis.

33.title: Gaan's Crossroads
33.tagline: The last crossroads before the road climbs into the mountains.
33.description: A major junction below the pass where the roads from the tavern, Onar's lands and the high pastures meet. Beyond it the path climbs toward the gate of the Valley of Mines.
33.history: Gaan is a hunter stationed near the approach to the pass. He warns travelers of a monstrous snapper that hunts in the area and is eager to see it slain. Mercenaries such as Buster also patrol this frontier of Onar's territory.

characters.name: Gaan
characters.description: A watchful hunter who knows every beast near the pass.

characters.name: Buster
characters.description: One of Lee's men, quick to test a newcomer's mettle with his fists.

34.title: West Pasture Rim
34.tagline: Cliffside grazing land in a dispute between shepherds and farmers.
34.description: Windswept cliff-edge pastures on the western rim of the high plateau, with lush grass that sheep love.
34.history: Balthasar, a shepherd working for Onar, wants to graze his flock on Bengar's pastures and needs Bengar's permission to do so. Small disputes like this between Onar and his tenants are a constant source of side quests.

characters.name: Balthasar
characters.description: One of Onar's shepherds, always searching for better grazing.

35.title: Bengar's Farm
35.tagline: The farm nearest the pass, first to fear what comes out of it.
35.description: A farm on the high pastures close to the pass leading into the Valley of Mines. Its isolation makes it vulnerable to anything that crosses the mountains.
35.history: As orcs and monsters begin coming through the pass, Bengar fears for his farm and asks for protection. The mercenary Wolf can be persuaded to guard it. Later in the game, some of his farmhands, including Malak, flee into the hills.

characters.name: Bengar
characters.description: A worried farmer on the frontier of the orc threat.

characters.name: Wolf
characters.description: May be sent to protect Bengar's farm.

characters.name: Malak
characters.description: A worker who flees the farm when danger grows too great.

36.title: Refugee Waterfall
36.tagline: A misty gorge where frightened farmhands take shelter.
36.description: A gorge of thundering waterfalls and hidden caves between Bengar's farm and the pass road.
36.history: When the monsters crossing the pass become too dangerous, farm workers hide in caves in the hills. Malak and his companions can be found sheltering in a cave, waiting for the danger to pass.

characters.name: Malak
characters.description: Bengar's worker, hiding with others in a cave above the waterfall.

37.title: Bandit Overlook
37.tagline: A guarded cliff path where wanted posters bear the hero's face.
37.description: A narrow cliff path leading into the southern mountains, ideal for ambushes.
37.history: In Night of the Raven, bandits all over Khorinis carry wanted posters of the hero, distributed by Dexter. Paths like this are where they lie in wait, hoping to claim the bounty.

characters.name: Bandits
characters.description: Bounty hunters who will attack the hero on sight.

38.title: Western Crags
38.tagline: A rocky ravine leading toward the necromancer's valley.
38.description: A rocky ravine connecting the west coast with the secluded valley below Xardas's tower. Goblins and wolves hide among the boulders.
38.history: The Fire Mage Karras investigates the dark magic of the Seekers in Gothic II. Wild, remote places like these crags are where traces of their influence are most likely to be found.

characters.name: Karras
characters.description: A magician of the monastery who studies summoning magic and the curse of the Seekers.

39.title: Troll Canyon
39.tagline: A narrow gorge where trolls block the way.
39.description: A deep, narrow canyon in the southern mountains. Mountain trolls and goblins make it a dangerous shortcut.
39.history: When the novice Pedro steals the Eye of Innos in Chapter 3, he flees into the wild with the artifact, pursued by the hero and novices of the monastery. His trail leads through the most dangerous parts of the island.

characters.name: Pedro
characters.description: The monastery's former gatekeeper, possessed by the Seekers, who flees with the Eye of Innos.

40.title: Grom's Camp
40.tagline: A woodsmen's glade at the foot of the southern peaks.
40.description: A clearing at the base of the southern mountains where hunters and woodsmen make camp.
40.history: Life on the edges of the wilderness is hard but free. Small camps like this one support those who live by the hunt and trade their goods at the tavern and the farms.

characters.name: Grom
characters.description: A woodsman who lives at the edge of the southern forests.

41.title: Shadowbeast Woods
41.tagline: A dark pine forest ruled by shadowbeasts.
41.description: A deep, dark pine forest in the south. Shadowbeasts, massive horned predators, lurk in its caves.
41.history: Shadowbeasts have been feared since the days of the Penal Colony. Their horns and pelts fetch a high price from bowyers like Bosper, who gladly buys trophies from capable hunters.

characters.name: Bosper
characters.description: Buys the furs and trophies that hunters bring back from forests like this one.

characters.name: Shadowbeast
characters.description: A huge, horned beast that hunts alone at night.

42.title: Minental Ridge
42.tagline: A high ridge watching over the road to the Valley of Mines.
42.description: A critical mountain ridge on the approaches to the pass. Watchfires here can be seen from the valley and the plains alike.
42.history: Diego was a shadow in the Old Camp in Gothic and the first to help the hero in the colony. In Gothic II he stays in the Valley of Mines, then returns to Khorinis and can join the voyage to Irdorath. He appears again in Gothic 3.

characters.name: Diego
characters.description: A sharp, pragmatic survivor and expert marksman, one of the hero's four friends from the colony. In Gothic 3 he is met near the coastal town of Ardea.

43.title: Ruins of the Builders
43.tagline: Stepped pyramids of a forgotten civilization.
43.description: The weathered ruins of the Builders, an ancient civilization that worshiped Adanos. Their stepped pyramids and carved stone tablets puzzle the Water Mages.
43.history: In Night of the Raven, the Water Mages uncover the Builders' ruins on Khorinis and discover that this lost people once lived in Jharkendar. Riordian studies their writings and later brews potions for the Water Mages' camp.

characters.name: Riordian
characters.description: A scholar and alchemist of the Circle of Water.

facts: The Builders' stone tablets can be studied once the hero has learned their language.

44.title: Water Mages' Excavation
44.tagline: The dig site where the Circle of Water found the gate to Jharkendar.
44.description: An underground excavation site filled with ancient corridors, tunnels and stone guardians. The Water Mages have set up their research camp here.
44.history: Saturas, the head of the Water Mages in Gothic's New Camp, leads the excavation. Lares escorts the hero here at the start of Night of the Raven. The mages discover a portal, but the ornament needed to activate it is broken. Nefarius sends the hero to collect its missing pieces.

characters.name: Saturas
characters.description: Stern and cautious, he has never forgiven the hero for draining the ore heap in Gothic.

characters.name: Nefarius
characters.description: Researches the portal and the ornament ring needed to open it.

45.title: Portal to Jharkendar
45.tagline: An ancient gate to a lost valley of gold, pirates and evil.
45.description: A circular stone portal of the Builders, deep within the excavation. Once the ornament ring is restored, it opens a path to Jharkendar, a hidden valley on the north-east of the island.
45.history: Jharkendar holds the Builders' city, Captain Greg's pirate camp and a bandit camp ruled by Raven, the former ore baron. Raven, possessed by Beliar, seeks the Claw of Beliar in the temple of Adanos. The Water Mages fear that his ritual will unleash disaster across Khorinis.

characters.name: Merdarion
characters.description: Studies the teleportation stones that link the ruins of Jharkendar.

characters.name: Raven
characters.description: Escaped the colony and now commands the bandits in Jharkendar.

characters.name: Quarhodron
characters.description: An ancient warrior whose spirit can be summoned to reveal the Builders' secrets.

facts: The Claw of Beliar is one of the most powerful weapons in Gothic II.

46.title: Xardas's Valley
46.tagline: Where the hero first wakes and meets an old friend.
46.description: A secluded valley at the foot of the necromancer's tower. Its paths lead down toward Cavalorn's valley and the farms.
46.history: After being pulled from the ruins of the Sleeper's temple, the hero awakens in Xardas's tower at the beginning of Gothic II. Lester, an old friend from the Brotherhood of the Sleeper, waits by a campfire in the valley below and explains how things stand on Khorinis.

characters.name: Lester
characters.description: An old friend from the swamp camp in Gothic. He reappears in Gothic 3.

47.title: Golem Defile
47.tagline: A stone pass guarded by animated golems.
47.description: A rocky defile where stone and fire golems block the way, guardians from a forgotten age.
47.history: Golems in the Gothic series are immune to most blades. They can be defeated only with blunt weapons or the proper magic. Serpentes, the strict High Council Fire Mage, is known for setting harsh trials for those who would rise in the monastery.

characters.name: Serpentes
characters.description: A suspicious magician who imposes demanding trials on the hero.

characters.name: Golems
characters.description: Stone, fire and ice golems, each vulnerable to different attacks.

48.title: Pass Gorge
48.tagline: A steep canyon approach to the mountain pass.
48.description: A steep rocky canyon leading up toward the paladins' barricade at the pass.
48.history: Gorn, mercenary of the New Camp in Gothic, joins the paladin expedition into the valley but ends up in Garond's dungeon. The hero can secure his release, and Gorn later fights at his side and sails with him to Irdorath. He appears again in Gothic 3.

characters.name: Gorn
characters.description: A huge, good-humored warrior wielding a massive axe, one of the hero's closest allies. In Gothic 3 he is again imprisoned, this time by the orcs in Gotha.

49.title: Xardas's Tower
49.tagline: The necromancer's spire, where every chapter of the story begins.
49.description: A tall, isolated tower in the mountains, filled with tomes, summoning circles and demonic servants.
49.history: Xardas left the Circle of Fire to study black magic. In Gothic his tower stood in the orc lands of the Penal Colony. In Gothic II he rescues the hero from the Sleeper's temple and resurrects him in this new tower, sending him to warn the paladins of the dragons. In Gothic 3 Xardas's schemes take the hero across Myrtana.

characters.name: Xardas
characters.description: The enigmatic master of black magic who guides the hero against the forces of Beliar.

facts: Xardas's demon servants guard the tower and its secrets.

50.title: Paladin Barricade
50.tagline: Palisades and crossbowmen holding back the orc tide.
50.description: A heavily defended palisade guarding the road between the pass and the plains.
50.history: The paladin expedition sent into the Valley of Mines found itself trapped by orcs and dragons. Defensive lines and watch posts like this one are all that stand between the orcs and the rest of Khorinis.

characters.name: Sengrath
characters.description: A crossbowman of Garond's expedition who vanished beyond the walls one night. His comrade Udar asks the hero to find out what happened to him.

51.title: Abandoned Mine Shaft
51.tagline: An ore mine abandoned in the chaos after the Barrier fell.
51.description: A mountain mine overlooking the Valley of Mines, its tunnels now home to minecrawlers rather than miners.
51.history: Magic ore from the valley's mines powered King Rhobar's war against the orcs. In Gothic II, the paladin expedition sends miners into the valley but the mines are overrun, leaving only a few survivors such as Grimes.

characters.name: Grimes
characters.description: A digger who survived the attacks and keeps mining ore despite the danger.

facts: Minecrawlers and their warrior caste are the bane of every miner in the valley.

52.title: Castle of the Valley of Mines
52.tagline: Gomez's old castle, now the paladins' last stand against dragons.
52.description: A fortified castle in the heart of the Valley of Mines, the former seat of the ore barons of the Old Camp. In Gothic II its walls are scorched and under siege by orcs and dragons.
52.history: Commander Garond leads the paladin expedition trapped in the castle. He needs proof of the ore reserves to send to Lord Hagen. The four dragons of the valley (swamp, rock, fire and ice) terrorize the castle until the hero hunts them down.

characters.name: Garond
characters.description: Determined to hold the castle at all costs despite overwhelming odds.

characters.name: Oric & Parcival
characters.description: Garond's advisors in the castle hall.

characters.name: Engor
characters.description: Rations the castle's scarce supplies.

facts: In Gothic this castle was the Old Camp, seat of the ore baron Gomez.

53.title: Mine Pass Tunnel
53.tagline: An underground route through the mountains.
53.description: A dark cavern route that bypasses the surface pass, used by scouts and those who would rather avoid the orcs.
53.history: Scouts of the expedition, such as Jergan, risk their lives to slip through the mountains and report on the orc forces in the valley.

characters.name: Jergan
characters.description: A ranger of the expedition who knows every hidden route through the pass.

54.title: Gate to the Valley of Mines
54.tagline: The threshold of the former Penal Colony.
54.description: The great gate where the pass descends into the Valley of Mines, the former Penal Colony.
54.history: In Gothic the valley was sealed by a magic Barrier created by twelve mages. It fell when the hero banished the Sleeper. In Chapter 2 of Gothic II, the hero crosses here to find the paladin expedition and prove that dragons have returned.

characters.name: Udar
characters.description: Keeps watch on the castle walls and worries about his missing comrade Sengrath.

characters.name: Brutus
characters.description: Runs the castle dungeon and trains strength. His assistant Den fled with his cash box during an orc attack.

facts: The Barrier had held thousands of convicts in the valley for more than ten years before it fell.
